distance.basis: L = WGS84 geodesic length of the OSM geometry in km; the 2026 map is a temporal surrogate.

congestion.basis: L x g, where g = 1 - 1/(1 + 0.15*x^4) per road segment and hour from data/processed/temporal/traffic_hourly.csv and x is a seeded, assumed demand-to-capacity index (hourly profile, road-type factor, weekend factor, repeatable daily per-city, three-hour per-area, static per-road and three-hour per-road variation). Project assumptions, not measurements, vehicle counts or independently estimated demand.

travel_time.basis: T (min) = free-flow time x BPR travel-time factor of the same assumed scenario x assumed weather multiplier. Posted OSM speed is only a free-flow proxy; fallback speeds are assumptions.

intersections.basis: I = 1 when the segment's downstream node has OSM street_count >= 3: one encounter per traversed approach; geometry vertices are not nodes. Current topology is a temporal surrogate.

signals.basis: S = 1 when the downstream node has an OSM traffic_signals tag: one encounter per traversed approach. Missing tags are assumed absent, not confirmed absent.

road_type.basis: L x p, p_k = 1 - median free-flow speed of OSM class k / the largest class median over development roads. A stated preference for faster classes, not a published penalty.

time_profile.basis: L x h, h = mean congestion of the road's group (city x road type) for the day category (weekday/weekend) and local hour over development dates only; falls back to road type, then all roads. The clock hour itself is not a penalty.

weather.basis: L x a, a = assumed severity of the hourly category from the nearest 0.05-degree provider grid (1-hour precipitation: >= 7.5 mm heavy rain, > 0 rain). Kept separate from flood exposure. Severities and speed multipliers are assumptions, not calibrated.

flood_exposure.basis: Sum over portions of km inside each NOAH five-year hazard class x assumed class severity (class/3 scenario; alternatives equal and convex). Overlaps resolve to the highest class. Mapped susceptibility, not current inundation or closure; no bridge elevation correction.

capacity_burden.basis: L / K, K = directional lanes x assumed 1,900 veh/h/lane base saturation flow x g/C (0.5 assumed at a mapped signal, else 1). Inverse capacity is a provisional study mapping, not a universal published road penalty; lanes and signal timings are unvalidated.
